description: This file defines the JsonPatch interface for representing JSON Patch operations, including methods for creating patches, retrieving operation details, and converting to JSON. It also includes nested enums and classes for patch operations and JSON fields.

classes.name: JsonPatch
classes.description: Interface representing a JSON Patch with methods to create and access patch details.

classes.name: JsonPatch.Operation
classes.description: Enum defining supported JSON Patch operation types: add, remove, replace.

classes.name: JsonPatch.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class containing definitions for JSON fields used in JSON Patch objects.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new JsonPatch instance with specified operation, path, and value.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Returns the type of operation for this patch.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path for this patch.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the value for the patch, if applicable.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns the JSON object representation of this patch.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the minimal JSON string representation of this patch.
